Chen Mobai.name: Chen Mobai
Chen Mobai.clothing: Standard Immortal Sect Fifth High School uniform: a sleek, dark blue jacket with silver trim over a white shirt, matching dark blue trousers, and comfortable, futuristic-looking sneakers.
Chen Mobai.distinguishing_features: A slim, jade-colored smartphone carried in his pocket. He has a sharp, handsome face with a confident, sometimes smug, expression.
Chen Mobai.disposition: Smug and confident after his breakthrough, but envious of top students.
Chen Mobai.personality: Ambitious, hardworking, slightly arrogant, values his True Spiritual Root status.
Chen Mobai.voice_notes: Male, 17-18. Adam's polished, trustworthy, low-pitch voice conveys the confidence and slight arrogance of a protagonist with a True Spiritual Root, fitting his smug yet ambitious disposition.
Chen Mobai.vocal_description: Clear, confident, and slightly youthful male voice.

Chai Deyun.name: Chai Deyun
Chai Deyun.clothing: A formal, dark gray teacher's robe with subtle geometric patterns, worn over a simple tunic. He wears a pair of thin, wire-rimmed glasses.
Chai Deyun.distinguishing_features: A stern expression usually, but can soften. Carries a digital tablet for student records.
Chai Deyun.disposition: Stern but proud of his students' achievements.
Chai Deyun.personality: Dedicated, traditional, observant, cares for his students' futures.
Chai Deyun.voice_notes: Male, mid-30s. George's classic British, mature voice with a measured delivery suits a dedicated, traditional teacher who is stern but proud, fitting his older age and observant nature.
Chai Deyun.vocal_description: Deep, authoritative, and slightly gravelly male voice.

Deskmate.name: Deskmate
Deskmate.clothing: Same school uniform as Chen Mobai, but worn less neatly; jacket unbuttoned, shirt slightly wrinkled.
Deskmate.distinguishing_features: A perpetually envious expression, often seen leaning over to look at others' screens.
Deskmate.voice_notes: Male, 17-18. Eric's clear, neutral voice matches the observant and competitive personality of a minor character, conveying frustration without overpowering the scene.
Deskmate.vocal_description: Younger, slightly higher-pitched male voice with a hint of whining.

Song Zheng.name: Song Zheng
Song Zheng.clothing: Immaculate Immortal Sect Fifth High School uniform, worn with perfect precision. A small, high-tech pin on his lapel denotes his high status.
Song Zheng.distinguishing_features: A focused, intense gaze. Carries a sleek, black cultivation accessory on his belt.
Song Zheng.personality: Driven, disciplined, naturally gifted, top student.
Song Zheng.voice_notes: Male, 17-18. Fenrir's energetic and clear voice at a faster speed reflects the driven, disciplined, and naturally gifted top student's focused and confident disposition.
Song Zheng.vocal_description: Clear, steady, and mature male voice for his age.

Yan Bingxuan.name: Yan Bingxuan
Yan Bingxuan.hair_style: long, straight, tied back with a simple ribbon
Yan Bingxuan.clothing: Immaculate Immortal Sect Fifth High School uniform, tailored to fit her slender frame. She wears a delicate, silver bracelet on her wrist.
Yan Bingxuan.distinguishing_features: An ethereal, almost aloof beauty. Her posture is always perfect.
Yan Bingxuan.voice_notes: Female, 17-18. Heart's warm, conversational, and natural breathiness conveys intelligence, grace, and poise, fitting her serene and slightly distant demeanor as a talented observer.
Yan Bingxuan.vocal_description: Soft, melodic, and clear female voice.

Late Classmate.name: Late Classmate
Late Classmate.clothing: Standard school uniform, slightly disheveled from running. A backpack is slung over one shoulder.
Late Classmate.distinguishing_features: A flushed face from running and frustration. Often seen in a hurry.
Late Classmate.voice_notes: Male, 17-18. Puck's energetic, youthful voice at a faster speed matches the impulsive, competitive, and easily annoyed personality, conveying frustration and hurry. Note: Puck is marked as TAKEN, but per rules, we prefer available voices; however, no other male voice fits the energetic/young profile as well. If strict availability is required, we could use am_echo with speed 1.2, but Puck is the best match. Since the rule says 'Prefer available over TAKEN', I will switch to am_echo to adhere strictly.

Immortal Sect Fifth High School Classroo.name: Immortal Sect Fifth High School Classroom
Immortal Sect Fifth High School Classroo.description: A modern, spacious classroom with large, floor-to-ceiling windows offering a panoramic view of Danxia City's futuristic skyline. The room is filled with sleek, individual desks and a high-tech podium at the front. Sunlight streams in, creating a bright, airy atmosphere.
Immortal Sect Fifth High School Classroo.architecture_style: Futuristic, minimalist with clean lines and integrated technology.
Immortal Sect Fifth High School Classroo.color_palette: Cool blues, whites, and metallic grays with warm sunlight accents.

Immortal Sect Fifth High School Walkway.name: Immortal Sect Fifth High School Walkway
Immortal Sect Fifth High School Walkway.description: A wide, paved walkway connecting the school buildings to the Cultivation Hall. It's lined with sleek, metallic railings and holographic signposts. Students are seen moving quickly along it. The background features the towering, ornate architecture of the Cultivation Hall and the sprawling city beyond.
Immortal Sect Fifth High School Walkway.architecture_style: Futuristic, with elements of grand, ornate sect architecture.
Immortal Sect Fifth High School Walkway.color_palette: Steel gray, silver, and bright sky blue.

Cultivation Hall Exterior.name: Cultivation Hall Exterior
Cultivation Hall Exterior.description: A grand, imposing building with intricate carvings and glowing runes on its facade. It has multiple entrances with large, heavy doors. Students are rushing towards it. The building exudes an aura of power and ancient technology.
Cultivation Hall Exterior.architecture_style: Grand, ornate, with futuristic elements integrated into traditional sect design.
Cultivation Hall Exterior.color_palette: Deep bronze, gold, and dark stone.

Cultivation Chamber.name: Cultivation Chamber
Cultivation Chamber.description: A small, sterile, three-square-meter room with smooth, metallic walls and a single, padded floor mat in the center. The only features are a small electronic panel on one wall with a display and a scanner, and a subtle ventilation system. The atmosphere is quiet and focused.
Cultivation Chamber.color_palette: Sterile white, light gray, and metallic silver.
